authorization_basis.interpretation: Authorize preparation and revision of one first publish-ready clip and reusable social template; no publication authorization inferred.

baseline.color: V06 provisional, preserve exact current source/color binding

execution.action: Inspect latest repo and local instructions. Reuse installed verified fonts and existing native templates/project. Preserve existing local changes and originals. Only one process controls Resolve.

Create two mobile-first still treatments on representative real frames from current 24-second clip, with clearly larger typography, short text chunks and strong hierarchy. Initial size exploration may use 1.5x and 2x current body/artist sizing, then fit by actual rendered glyph dimensions, not blindly multiplying all sizes. These are design candidates, not Nitin-selected settings. Show both actual 1080x1920 output and an accurately scaled 360x640 phone-size comparison. Keep face/mouth unobscured and verify actual text bounds. Use actual linebreaks. Return review links before another full comparison render.

Develop one complete reusable 9:16 social template around existing native components: brief hook, song/artist identifier, optional verified selective lyrics, brief ending. Captions need not be continuous. Preserve performance-first branding. Include separately verified platform-safe overlay presets for Reels, TikTok and Shorts; generic 10% margins are not evidence of platform safety. Verify current official upload and display requirements during execution, record source/date and uncertainty. Do not buy packs or install third-party effects.

In parallel with still review, prepare concrete rhythm revision using recovered Claude detector map and Gemini output QC. Cover the full 24s with deliberate musical pacing; review gaps and recovery curves. Do not force an effect on every beat, assume low/high bands are kick/snare, or label every fourth beat a true downbeat. Validate music and expression against playback. Stay within the existing bounded preview scope; do not expand to a full master.

After Nitin selects the still treatment, render one integrated 24s candidate using chosen caption design and prepared rhythm revision. Include no lyric-demo placeholders in a publish candidate; omit optional lyrics if unverifiable. Do not treat still selection as final video or publish approval. Export reusable DRP/config with verified second-text reuse, proper cache invalidation and hashes.

Prepare one review bundle: exact video, cover image, draft post text, verified credits/rights questions, platform-specific preflight results, source/hash manifest and remaining decisions. No platform upload, schedule or post without a separate explicit gate. If cover clearance/platform check is unresolved label candidate accordingly, not unconditionally publish-ready.

Run full video/audio decode, 10-bit HLG metadata checks, mobile legibility/safe-zone visual inspection and lipsync/motion playback review. Obtain independent Gemini review of exact final candidate when available; describe limitations, not calibrated HDR claims. Persist production assets on Shared Drive and code/evidence in GitHub, verify readback, supply direct links.

autonomy: Routine font/Resolve recovery already authorized. Do not ask Nitin to relay agent messages or execute routine commands. Do not wait for unrelated ledger work to prepare assets; report concrete unavailable access accurately.

state.instruction: Do not promote or rewrite Master State while ledger/reducer and pointer integrity holds remain. Preserve append-only evidence. No frozen component reopening.
